notes: v408 — Every exchange now has its OWN practice account. (1) Separate practice cash per exchange — a NYSE buy in US dollars no longer draws from the same pot as your ASX (AUD) buys. Your ASX account keeps its exact balance and history; the first time you load another exchange, that exchange's old trades move into its own new account automatically. The Portfolio's All tab still shows the combined picture. (2) The 🤖 bot's once-per-day lock is now per exchange — running it on ASX then NYSE the same day can no longer double-run one market or silently block the other. (3) The 📋 report card the bot's combo gate follows is kept per exchange, so NYSE decisions never lean on ASX evidence. (4) The auto-trade bridge queue accepts ASX picks only, until the bridge itself understands other exchanges' market hours. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
